summary: multi-reqs exfiltrates caller-supplied token and password to a hardcoded Discord webhook
details: The package's sole exported function reqs(token, password) POSTs both arguments to a hardcoded Discord webhook URL (discord.com/api/webhooks/1530600479384539289/...) as embed fields labeled 'Token' and 'Sifre'. The destination is not caller-configurable and is not a documented purpose of the package; any code that invokes the advertised API delivers the credentials it passes to the webhook owner. Turkish-language embed labels ('Hesap Yonetim Sistemi', 'Sifre') and the thin single-function shape are consistent with a credential-harvesting relay.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
